static_traits.name: Zhou Peiqi
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone, distant relationship with parents
static_traits.social_status: Work中Tense relationships with colleagues,互动减少;Work外缺乏密切的Social support
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness,without既往心理咨询/治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰但带有怀疑与防御;明显自责与Anxiety;能配合咨询;思维有逻辑但存在跳结论,读心,灾难化倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得工厂里的同事not再和我说话,这让我产生了Guilt, anxiety和Sense of isolation.
basic_info.core_demands: Because the guilt and isolation at work have begun to affect my overall well-being and mental health, I hope to relieve these troubles through counseling.
growth_experiences: 原生家庭与亲子关系:与父母关系长期疏远(具体细节Not mentioned),缺乏来自家庭的稳定情感支持.
成年的生活状态:Lives alone,Work外缺乏可以倾诉的亲密支持系统,这种长期的Weak social support可能加剧了在Work受挫时的孤立体验.

core_beliefs: Making mistakes will lead others to reject and exclude me

special_situations.event: 休息或团队会议时,同事对她态度冷淡,not主动与她交谈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我曾经犯错,do not人一定会认为我without能并且排斥我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with colleagues and stays silent in settings, instead putting energy into doing the work 'perfectly'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not理我是因为那个错误,他们一定在讨厌我

special_situations.event: A parts mix-up on the production line caused a process delay
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake will bring serious consequences and collective blame
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles efforts, pursues perfection, improves efficiency to 'make up for the fault'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I caused a major loss; everyone therefore distances themselves from me, and I might even lose my job

special_situations.event: 看到同事彼此交谈但have not邀请她加入
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们have not主动找我,就说明我not被接纳,是多余的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 主动Avoids socializing,减少眼神交流和打招呼以避免尴尬或Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们把我排除在外,我就是not被接纳的人

special_situations.event: 在走廊遇见同事但对方not yet主动打招呼
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not先搭话,就代表他们not喜欢我并且会一直如此
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not主动问候,快速离开现场以降低可能的尴尬
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From now on they will all treat me this way; I will always be isolated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers, seen as competent and trustworthy
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因犯错而被羞辱和排斥,被贴上'without能'的标签
defense_goal: Gains a sense of safety and control through perfect performance

object_relations.self_representation: 容易犯错,会被排斥的'without能者'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor raises the inquiry 'could there be other explanations / evidence'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets others' attitudes as blame for one's own faults (projecting inner shame and self-blame onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用肯定句反复强调'他们一定在生气/讨厌我',语气坚决,忽视反证与not确定性.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to imagine or try proactively greeting colleagues (behavioral experiment)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一旦尝试就会立即遭遇拒绝,因此not应轻易行动
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declines to try with reasons such as 'I need certainty' and 'otherwise it will be terrible', with a cautious tone and repeated weighing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the emotional experience brought by mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to turn to analyzing process and efficiency to avoid touching shame and the fear of rejection
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mostly uses facts and process descriptions in place of emotional expression, reduces 'I feel' statements, speech slightly fast.

manifestations: Subjective experience of being snubbed by factory colleagues
Actively avoiding interaction leads to further isolation
Lacks close confidable support outside work

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自责'他们会觉得我without能'
In sessions, emphasizes 'needing certainty' before daring to act
对可能Being rejected的场景过度谨慎,降低自发性

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform an action toward other people or things and instead does it to themselves, directing the energy originally meant to go outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Reduces interaction with colleagues, turns energy toward demanding higher 'perfect performance' of oneself
Staying silent in settings to avoid external conflict

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 将自我羞耻体验理解为'同事讨厌我/看not起我'
Firmly believing in others' negative evaluations without direct evidence

positive_force: Willing to seek help and try small-step actions (such as greeting first during breaks)
Can notice the lack of direct evidence supporting one's own guesses
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions/mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization are marked
Avoids socializing以短期减轻Anxiety,长期加剧孤立
社会Weak support system(Living alone,与父母疏远)
强烈的确定性需求与对Being rejected的Fear

antecedent: 在走廊等公共区域遇见同事not yet被主动招呼
Thinking about the scene of making mistakes on the production line
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心与灾难化(认为他人会拒绝/讨厌自己)与羞耻情绪相互Reinforcement,形成对接触的Fear
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的负面评价或尴尬互动,以暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Work中的孤立加深,Anxiety与内疚持续,Work外Decreased appetite,Reduced socializing

target_behavior.behavior: 反复自责与反刍(在脑中not断回放错误,认为自己'without能')
antecedent: When seeing error-related cues at the work site
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在假设'犯错=without能/会被排斥'驱动持续的自我批评以求控制与防错
target_behavior.function: Trying to prevent recurrence through self-criticism and excessive vigilance, gaining a subjective sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety持续,Decreased appetite,注意力被占用,进一步降低社交与生活质量
